plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. HEADING AS PRINTED: the map page heads 'MATH map for 2026-2027' followed by 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The map page does NOT print a 'This pathway map is for catalog year ...' sentence; the 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated, except the small closed sets named in these notes where the browser verified them. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / MATH / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-64.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full. The program name is printed 'MATH' in the mapper and is transcribed as printed. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-17 / 15 / 15-16 and a plan total of 60-64.5 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. MATH C2211 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. MATH C2211, MATH C2221, MATH B6C, MATH B6D and MATH B6E carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. No 'Major List' slot appears on this map. The small closed dropdown sets verified on the Geology map for Areas 1A, 1C, 1B, 6 and 5B are the same on this map (browser-verified); per the standing slot convention they are named in the Geology plan notes and the slots here are recorded unselected.
